summary.question: Performance monitoring shows degraded signal quality on service svc385 (100GE between S18 and S05) from about t=540 s. What is the cause?

llm.report: The system concluded that the degraded signal quality on svc385 was caused by WSS attenuation drift at el:oms.S04-S15|4(). Confidence is 99.6%. No supporting checks were reported. The diagnosis required no engineering effort or site visits.

template: Cause: WSS_ATTEN_DRIFT@el:oms.S04-S15|4() (probability 0.996). Checks made: none. Effort: 0.0 h of tests and travel, 0 site visit(s).
